## Pull request overview

This PR implements an automated Git merge driver configuration to handle `pnpm-lock.yaml` conflicts in CI workflows, eliminating manual conflict resolution during automated operations.

**Changes:**
- Added custom merge driver configuration to three workflows that may encounter lockfile conflicts
- Updated pnpm version from 9 to 10 across workflows for consistency  
- Documented the merge driver setup and usage in the workflows documentation

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml` | Added checkout, pnpm/Node.js setup, and merge driver configuration for automated dependency updates |
| `.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml` | Added merge driver configuration and updated pnpm to v10 for release operations |
| `.github/workflows/changeset-check.yml` | Updated pnpm version to v10 for consistency |
| `.github/workflows/changelog.yml` | Added merge driver configuration for automated changelog updates |
| `.github/WORKFLOWS.md` | Added comprehensive documentation section explaining the merge driver setup, usage, and benefits |
</details>

The merge driver is configured but pnpm is not installed in this workflow. The driver command 'pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile' will fail if triggered because there are no pnpm setup steps. Either add pnpm/Node.js setup steps before this configuration, or remove this configuration if merge operations are not expected in this workflow.
